attempts.summary: Implemented an Ansible playbook (run from node2, the only node with Ansible installed, targeting node1) that provisions a file-backed LUKS2 encrypted volume that auto-unlocks via a root-only keyfile at boot and auto-mounts at /srv/secure via crypttab + fstab. Verified auto-unlock/mount across a real reboot of node1, then completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol on both node1 and node2, confirming boot-identity changes and full recovery of required services/data on each.
